source.publication: IFO General Fund Budget Update, Jul 2026 + Fiscal Outlook (Nov 2025, pre-enactment vintage)

projections.notes: Enacted budget passed Nov 2025. Revenue updated to actual FY 2025-26 close-out ($48.93B, IFO June 2026 Revenue Update) — 5.4% / $2.52B above FY 2024-25. Spending figure is still the enacted-budget estimate; actual year-end spending not yet confirmed.

Revised post-enactment estimate from IFO's General Fund Budget Update (July 14, 2026), which updates the financial statement for the FY 2026-27 enacted budget — down from a pre-enactment estimate of $5.56B. Cited via Commonwealth Foundation (https://commonwealthfoundation.org/research/deficit-watch-july-2026/); the primary IFO PDF is JS-gated and hasn't been directly verified. Supersedes the earlier $6.7B 'no policy changes' Five-Year Outlook figure below in growthTrend.
IFO 5-year Fiscal Outlook — not yet revised post-enactment; treat as the older vintage alongside the FY 2025-26 and FY 2026-27 figures above.

growthTrend.note: Historical figures are IFO-consistent estimates. FY 2025-26 revenue is actual close-out ($48.93B); spending is still the enacted-budget estimate. FY 2026-27 onward: revenue compounds at IFO's ~2%/yr from the FY 2025-26 actual base; spending is set so each year's gap (spending minus revenue) matches the structural deficit figures in the projections array above ($5.03B FY 2026-27, post-enactment; $8.4B FY 2029-30, pre-enactment vintage, not yet revised), interpolated in between. Recomputed 2026-07 after the FY 2025-26 actual came in well above the prior enacted-budget estimate — the old projected points implied revenue falling year over year, which didn't happen.
